summary: Verified user-management visibility bug fix on /final and quick regressions. All targeted tests passed.

issues: Hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (likely emergent instrumentation span inside <option>). Existed before this change.

critical_code_review_comments: isAdmin fallback (!me?.role || role==='Admin') is intentional for backward-compat but broadens admin privileges to any legacy/malformed auth object. Consider migrating old localStorage entries or requiring re-login post-deploy to avoid privilege escalation risk.
seed_data_creation: Created user 'ravi' (role=User) via UI on /final during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TEST1 (fresh admin login): user-name, user-username, user-password, user-role, user-create-btn, users-table, user-create-row all present; no 'Only Admin' text. TEST2: create user Ravi/ravi/pass1234/User -> user-row-ravi visible with 'User' pill. TEST3 (legacy auth {user:'admin', at}): user-create-btn, user-create-row, user-delete-ravi all still visible after reload+goto /final. TEST4a /vendor field-tempRefId = 'Generated on First Save'. TEST4b /bill btn-add-item-row adds a tr[data-testid^='item-row-'] (0 -> 1). TEST4c /final has exactly 1 .a4 element. Pre-existing hydration warning in /bill (span inside option in GST slab select) is unrelated to this fix.
rca of the issue: Older localStorage AUTH objects lacked role -> isAdmin evaluated false -> whole user-create-row was hidden with 'Only Admin...' fallback. Fix in Reports.jsx: (a) removed isAdmin gate around create form, (b) isAdmin computed as !me?.role || me?.role==='Admin'. Verified both changes render correctly for fresh Admin login and legacy auth object.
